ValidationRule.description: Non-draft projects must kick off in the same ISO year as the start date and within 2 ISO weeks of it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Kickoff_At__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Draft')), OR( ISOYEAR(DATEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c)) <> ISOYEAR(Start_Date__c), ABS(ISOWEEK(DATEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c)) - ISOWEEK(Start_Date__c)) > 2 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Kickoff must fall in the same ISO year and within 2 ISO weeks of the Start Date.
